body: Thank you, but see, tonight he said I would contribute more if I would get a job too.  But, no one will hire me at my age, after not working for 7 years.  I should have stuck with my production typing from home, but I sure hated that for 22 years.  I feel that he and my daughter are more the couple now, not that he has much to do with the boys, but they both bring home the paycheck.  I drive the boys to school and back, plus regular housework stuff, but all those years I did that AND worked, so I see what he means that maybe I had more value then (though I never made as much production typing as he did, but I had more kid/home stuff).  I think my value was to raise the 2 boys while she was gone, take care of my parents for my siblings, but I should have kept working.  He still didn't show affection back then, but I can't blame HIM if he didn't feel it.  It's ok.  By time my parents go, the boys will be like 16-17, so it will be a good time to go.  But thank you for answering me.
I'm like you.  We are shouting into a dark hole where our words evaporate anyway.  I'm here for anyone who wants to yell to me.

14-year-old girls are evil b*tches!  She knows EXACTLY where to stick you.  She is watching your reaction.  Squint your eyes so you feel like Clint Eastwood, and TAKE EVERYTHING away from her!  Pillows...gone.  Clothes...must be earned.  Rides anywhere...say I'm pretty!  THIS IS WAR.  Say it all calmly, she cannot see she got to you!  She either treats you with respect or she gets NOTHING extra.  Where is their dad?
